scope: Android API29 software emulator, newly installed synthetic inspection app; not Galaxy hardware

read_only_observations.backup_only_cases: All three incompatible backup-only fixture directories already contained primary character.json files; same fixed test directory had been used by an earlier execution.
read_only_observations.valid_backup_case: Existing primary revision 2 was the previous valid snapshot, so saving it correctly produced a revision-2 backup rather than the fresh-fixture revision-1 expectation.
read_only_observations.pending_case: Read-only adb ls/readlink found both character.json and character.json.pending as actual symlinks to unrelated-fixture.txt in the old fixed fixture directory. The primary link dated from the earlier execution.
read_only_observations.unchanged_data: No Android fixture was removed, reset or overwritten by this diagnosis.

causes.effect: Four backup-only tests relied on fresh absent primaries but reused prior files. Do not attribute these assertions to save data loss.

Globalizing a path then DirAccess.open(absolute_parent) selected Android ACCESS_FILESYSTEM DirAccessJAndroid, which does not override is_link. The guard therefore missed real symlinks. Android ACCESS_USERDATA uses DirAccessUnix with native lstat/symlink support.

corrections: Root UI assigns each run a distinct fixture root and preserves old directories.
Store opens user:// to retain the native USERDATA backend, then change_dir to each absolute parent before is_link.
Suite creates links through that native backend with absolute source and target paths even when the suite root is absolute.
New regression requires native USERDATA detection of a genuine symlink and records the absolute FILESYSTEM backend observation separately. Existing protection assertions stay intact.

post_correction_validation.android_corrected_artifact: NOT_RUN_AT_DIAGNOSIS_WRITE; follow the later platform receipt

judgment: The original Android FAIL is preserved. Linux correction results do not establish Android or device PASS.
